items.notes: Repair of original 402 OCR-grouping defect, verified sound against visually-inspected PDF p59 Eq 7.5. Correct criterion is alpha >= (1-d)/k (numerator grouping (1-d), confirmed on temp/qit-page-59.png and Figure 1(a) d=2 giving alpha>=-1/k=(1-2)/k). Math checked by hand: (i) k=2, d>=3 => (1-d)/2 <= -1, and every admissible alpha>=-1 satisfies it, so EVERY d>=3 Werner state is 2-extendible (now TRUE universally, fixing the original item's false sub-claim); (ii) thresholds (1-d)/k are negative and increase to 0 as k grows, so holding for all k <=> alpha>=0 (if alpha<0, large k with (1-d)/k > alpha violates it) = separability threshold, limit 0 clean (NOT 1); (iii) isotropic with c=d/(d+1): x>=c(1-1/k) <=> 1/k>=1-x/c, so for 0<=x<c the allowed k are 1<=k<=1/(1-x/c), largest = floor of that; x>=c => all k; all-k threshold x>=d/(d+1). The explicit grouping remark ('(1-d)/k not 1-d/k; the latter tends to 1 and is a different false criterion') is correct and is the honest primary-typo/linearization admission. new_problem_core=false, aliased to original; no new core added. Repair is mathematically sound and faithful; accept.

Repair of original 411 (which carried the false intermediate 'U^T=conj(U^dagger) is false' and abandoned false-starts). Verified clean and sound. (a) Transpose trick: (X⊗I)|Phi>=(1/sqrt d)sum_{i,j}X(j,i)|j>|i>; (I⊗X^T)|Phi>=(1/sqrt d)sum_{i,j}X(i,j)|i>|j>, equal after dummy-index swap -- correct. (b) (U⊗barU)|Phi>=(I⊗barU)(U⊗I)|Phi>=(I⊗barU U^T)|Phi>, and barU U^T=conj(U U^dagger)=conj(I)=I, so invariant -- the derivation is now a single correct line with NO false statement (previously it wrongly called U^T=conj(U^dagger) 'false'; that identity is in fact true for every matrix). Explicit counterexample U=diag(1,i): U⊗U sends (|00>+|11>)/sqrt2 to (|00>-|11>)/sqrt2, verified, correctly showing un-conjugated U⊗U does NOT fix |Phi> and that the source Exercise 6.1 'U⊗U' wording is a genuine discrepancy repaired to U⊗barU. Basis-dependence of transpose/conjugate stated. new_problem_core=false, aliased; no new core. Sound; accept.

Equality iff tr[X(I-Pi_N)]=0, shown equivalent (for X>=0) to supp(X) in Sym^N via ||(I-Pi_N)X^{1/2}||_HS^2 = tr[X(I-Pi_N)] -- correct. Counterexample (|01>+|10>)/sqrt2 is symmetric (trace preserved) yet not a mixture of pure powers (pure entangled != convex comb of product pure states), correctly showing the condition is Sym^N-support, strictly larger than separable pure-power mixtures. new_problem_core=false, aliased; no new core.
